metric_notes.skip_rate: Instagram skip rate percentage when available
metric_notes.follows: new follows attributed to or observed from the reel when available
metric_notes.profile_visits: profile visits from reel when available
metric_notes.non_follower_reach_pct: percentage of reached accounts that were non-followers

reels.learning_note: Useful baseline only. Do not change strategy from one reel alone; wait for at least 3 comparable reels. The main warning is a high skip rate and zero follow conversion.
